# Multi-Brand Camera EXIF Test Fixtures

Each file in this directory is an 8×8 neutral gray JPEG containing the **unmodified, byte-for-byte original `APP1` (EXIF / MakerNote / XMP) metadata segments** extracted from a **CC0 1.0 Universal (Public Domain Dedication)** photograph hosted on Wikimedia Commons.

Replacing the compressed image scan data with an 8×8 solid block keeps each fixture under ~36 KB while preserving the exact binary metadata structures emitted by each camera manufacturer.
